xna-type.name: IContentProcessor
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for accessing a statically typed ContentProcessor subclass, using dynamically typed object data.

property.name: InputType
property.summary: Gets the expected object type of the input parameter to IContentProcessor.Process.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract Type InputType { get; }
property.value: Object type of the input parameter.

property.name: OutputType
property.summary: Gets the object type returned by IContentProcessor.Process.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract Type OutputType { get; }
property.value: Type of object returned by the processor.

method.name: Process
method.summary: Processes the specified input data and returns the result.

overload.summary: Processes the specified input data and returns the result.

parameters.parameter: Contains any required custom process parameters.

overload.returns: An object representing the processed input.
